Berit Klinik AG | Vogelinsegg 5 | 9042 memory | +41 71 335 06 06 | info@beritklinik.ch About the Berit Clinic The Berit Clinic Group operates seven locations in eastern Switzerland and is a leader in orthopedics, spinal surgery and rehabilitation in Speicher and Niederteufen.
